### Method and authorization

Confirm authorized read-only scope; no target/account identities. State effective permission scope without usernames. If only mocks ran, use a simulation bug report rather than this functional report.

### Results

Use docs/TEST-RESULT-TEMPLATE.md. Include failures, unknowns, unsupported/not-run checks, comparison with matching UI scope/time and sanitized error identifiers. Distinguish collection visibility from health or compliance.

### Evidence handling

Keep raw exports/logs private. Submit only manually reviewed, anonymized/fabricated reproductions. No credentials, tokens, internal identifiers or original screenshots. Contributor-reported results remain unverified until reviewed and apply only to this combination.
